concept: AWS Config: configuration history and continuous compliance
tests: Which service records the full history of resource configuration changes and evaluates them against rules.
expected: AWS Config: configuration history + continuous evaluation against Config rules. Triggers: "complete history of configuration changes", "evaluate against compliance rules over time".
why_not: CloudTrail is API activity, not configuration state over time; CloudWatch is metrics and logs; Trusted Advisor is point-in-time best-practice checks.
